capabilities: Parse Markdown files into learning units by heading hierarchy
Prompt the user to explain each section in their own words
Evaluate explanations with an OpenRouter-compatible LLM and give feedback
Unlock the next section only after sufficient grasp is demonstrated
Track per-file progress and session history
extras: Not yet on the Obsidian community plugin registry; manual installation required. BYOK model: the user supplies and pays for their own API access; requests go directly from Obsidian to the configured provider. Bilingual English/Simplified Chinese UI. Roadmap items (multi-agent review, quizzes, spaced repetition, exportable summaries) are not implemented yet.
problem: Reading long Markdown files in Obsidian is passive; without forced recall and feedback, readers retain little of what they read.

requires.name: LLM provider API key (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, OpenRouter, Moonshot, GLM, Ollama, or custom)

summary: Reading companion that splits Markdown documents into sections and gates progress on AI-judged explanations of each section.
